description: Land Title Settlement Department - Sitinamaluwa, D/S/Division Beliattta, Hambabthota District - Cad. Map No. 830116
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, encumbrances, and property rights. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and title settlements for specific land parcels in designated locations.
